test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Solve the following:

({cosec} 23^circ - sin 23^circ)(tan 23^circ + cot 23^circ)(sec 23^circ - cos 23^circ)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For trigonometric expressions of this form, the result is independent of the angle θ.

Substitute a standard angle, let θ = 45°.

⇒ (cosec 45° − sin 45°)(tan 45° + cot 45°)(sec 45° − cos 45°)

⇒ (√2 − 1/√2) × (1 + 1) × (√2 − 1/√2)

⇒ (1/√2) × 2 × (1/√2) = 2/2 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(cosec 23° − sin 23°)(tan 23° + cot 23°)(sec 23° − cos 23°)

**Formula Used:**

cosec θ = 1 / sin θ, sec θ = 1 / cos θ

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ, cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculations:**

Let θ = 23°.

⇒ (1 / sin θ − sin θ) × (sin θ / cos θ + cos θ / sin θ) × (1 / cos θ − cos θ)

⇒ [(1 − sin²θ) / sin θ] × [(sin²θ + cos²θ) / (sin θ × cos θ)] × [(1 − cos²θ) / cos θ]

⇒ [cos²θ / sin θ] × [1 / (sin θ × cos θ)] × [sin²θ / cos θ]

⇒ (cos²θ × 1 × sin²θ) / (sin θ × sin θ × cos θ × cos θ)

⇒ (sin²θ × cos²θ) / (sin²θ × cos²θ)

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Reciprocal Identities

sin θ = 1 / cosec θ, cos θ = 1 / sec θ, tan θ = 1 / cot θ.

Quotient Identities

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ, cot θ = cos θ / sin θ.
</p
